raw_segments.text: Third Witch. Scale of dragon, tooth of wolf, witch's mummy, maw and gulf of the ravened
salty shark, root of hemlock digged I.T.H. dark, liver of blaspheming Jew, gall of goat,
and slips of ewe slivered in the moon's eclipse, nose of Turk and tartar's lips, finger of
birth-strangled babe ditched delivered by a drab make the gruel thick and slab. Add there
to a tiger's shoran for T.H. ingredients of our cauldron.
